## Purpose
`emit_phase.rs`'s `PhaseOutcome` and `verify_emit.rs`'s `VerifyOutcome` are small `enum`s that name the closed set of results an emit/verify operation can produce (`Recorded`/`AlreadyThere`; `Found`/`Miss`), so the caller's success line and exit behavior branch on an exhaustive match rather than a stringly-typed flag. They exist specifically to stop "succeeded silently" from being indistinguishable from "succeeded with a side effect" or "already true" — a defect the `PhaseOutcome` doc comment calls out by name.

## Convention
Folder: apps/rt/src/commands/event/**, apps/rt/src/commands/review/qa_run/** · Extension: .rs · Files of this role in this subproject: 5
Both exemplars declare a private `#[derive(Debug, PartialEq, Eq)] enum` with 2 variants, one carrying data relevant to the branch (`Recorded { from: Option<String> }`, `Found { age_secs: i64 }`) and the other a bare unit variant for the "nothing happened / no match" case. A dedicated pure function (`success_line`, `scan`) matches exhaustively over the enum to produce the JSON/exit-code side effect, keeping the decision logic (which outcome) separate from the rendering logic (what to print).

## How to apply
A new emit/verify command in these two families that needs to distinguish "did work" from "already true"/"no match" declares its own outcome enum, `pub(crate)` visibility unless a sibling module needs it, and keeps the enum's variants data-carrying only where the caller's message needs that data — mirroring `PhaseOutcome::Recorded { from }`.
